title: Tech Note: Realtime Graphs in 4D Chart

historical_commentary.text: Real-time data visualization within a desktop database application was an innovative technique for the late 1990s. While 4D Chart has been discontinued, the concept of live-updating graphs remains relevant. Modern implementations would use web-based charting libraries with WebSocket or polling-based data feeds.
related_updates: Real-time charting is now typically handled by JavaScript charting libraries in web-based interfaces
4D's web server and REST API provide modern alternatives for serving live data to chart components
